newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle market quiet, no sales - trade.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets were quiet near midday Monday, with no reported sales, according to Nebraska market sources.
Sales were expected to be light until after the Christmas holiday on Wednesday, but could pick up if packers raise bids to $109.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, they said.
Current bids were mostly at $108.00, with asking levels at $109.00-$110.00, sources said. There were a few bids at $65.00 on a live basis against asking levels of $67.00.
This week's state-wide showlist was estimated near 74,000 head, down 4,700 from last week, sources said.
